fact: VOA reports UNHCR began registering the nearly 10,000 Senegalese refugees in Guinea-Bissau in 2018, after the government announced it would grant them citizenship.
VOA reports 333 Senegalese refugees in Pelundo were getting national ID cards on the same day.
A June 2017 UNHCR verification exercise in 11 villages registered 2,860 Senegalese refugees (1,710 newly) and gave them refugee ID cards, and over 300 refugee children received birth certificates.
